Overview

Microsoft 365 Copilot, explained

Microsoft 365 Copilot can draft documents, summarise meetings, analyse spreadsheets and find information across your files. But it can also surface files people shouldn't see if permissions aren't right.

We start with a readiness review of your data and sharing settings, then set up licences, train your team on practical uses and build Copilot agents for your own processes. You get a safe rollout and real time savings, not unused licences.

Who it's for

  • Businesses already on Microsoft 365
  • Teams wanting to save time on writing and admin
  • Leaders wanting AI without data risks
  • Organisations with processes Copilot agents could handle

Why it matters

Why Microsoft 365 Copilot matters for your business

Copilot can save real time: drafting emails and documents, summarising meetings, analysing spreadsheets and finding information across your files.

But Copilot can see anything a user has access to. If permissions are messy, it can surface sensitive files to the wrong people. That's why readiness matters.

We prepare your environment, roll out Copilot to the right people, train them on practical tasks and build agents for your processes, so you get value safely.

FAQ

Microsoft 365 Copilot questions

Do we need Microsoft 365 already?

Yes. Copilot is an add-on to eligible Microsoft 365 plans. We'll check your setup first.

Can you supply Copilot licences?

For Australian clients, yes. We can set up and train teams worldwide.

Which Microsoft 365 plans work with Copilot?

Copilot is an add-on to eligible business and enterprise plans. We'll confirm yours in the readiness review.

Should everyone get a Copilot licence?

Not necessarily. Many businesses start with the roles that benefit most.

Is our data used to train Copilot?

Microsoft states that Microsoft 365 Copilot doesn't use your organisation's data to train its foundation models. We'll walk you through the data protections.

What can Copilot agents do?

They can follow your processes, answer questions from your content and complete multi-step tasks inside Microsoft 365.

Will Copilot work in Teams meetings?

Yes. It can summarise meetings and list action items.

Is there a minimum number of licences?

Microsoft's licensing terms apply. We'll confirm the current requirements for you.
